title: An unfinished course
prompt: In the `completions` table, one learner hasn't finished their course, so their `completed_date` is empty. What does this program print? Type each line on its own line.
hints: A missing value is still part of its row. Does an empty cell change how many rows there are?
`columns` is a Python list, so `[-1]` is its last name.
Count the rows of `courses` and of `completions`; the result can be negative.
explanation: `count()` counts rows, and a row with an empty `completed_date` is still a row, so there are 6. `columns[-1]` is the last column name, `completed_date`. There are 4 courses, so `4 - 6` is `-2`.
